title: [research tooling] RESAMPLE BAR-LABEL LOOK-AHEAD (unmeasured effect): every harness _resample (backtest_trend/pullback/fade/squeeze/fvg_range/chop_scalp/funding_carry) aggregates OPEN-stamped native bars with label='right', closed='right'. Measured 2026-11-20 on synthetic 5m bars: the hourly bar labelled 01:00 holds the 5m bars opened 00:05..01:00, so its close is the 01:05 price; backtest_trend then sets bar_label='close' (01:00) -> one sub-bar of look-ahead (5 min for ETH/SOL 5m->1h, 15 min for BTC 15m->1h) and a 1-sub-bar stub at the series start. Affects every --resample run (D8 exit grid #27480, exit_lever_ablation) and, since the PI-20261119-RIMARY13-0002 fix, every resolver-resampled CLI run. Do: (1) measure the effect on one leg (ETH trend 1h: native-aligned label='left',closed='left' vs current, same window, net R and n); (2) if material, switch the convention behind a recorded A/B and list graded units on --resample runs.
